environment.compiled_core_note: built locally with maturin and git-ignored; that it was built from the commit above is not recorded by the build and is not verified here

gromacs.location: outside the repository, under the user's home (TOPOFOLD_GMX)
gromacs.used_by: check amendment a2 only (run-input reading); the comparison itself does not call GROMACS

recovery_steps: 1. Check out scientific-rebuild at or after the closeout commit; build the core (maturin develop --release) and the MDAnalysis environment (benchmarks/audit/wpd_local_retrieval).
2. Download PCA.zip, kinase_kinked_Myr.zip and kinase_kinked_noMyr.zip from doi:10.5061/dryad.9cnp5hqnx (version 5) in a browser into benchmarks/audit/abl_myr_1/data_dryad/.
3. Verify them: sha256sum -c results/ABL-MYR-1b_closeout_SHA256SUMS.txt (the archive lines must match; they equal the Dryad source digests).
4. To inspect the recorded result, nothing needs to be rerun: results/ABL-MYR-1b_results.json, the window CSVs, the report and the residue summary are committed.

5. To regenerate the intermediates for method development, run the comparison into a new output directory (--out and --work pointing outside results/ and work/), so that the recorded result files are not overwritten; a fresh output is a new run, not the recorded one, and byte-identity with the recorded intermediates has not been tested.
6. The a2 run-input check additionally needs GROMACS 2024.5 (results/ABL-MYR-1b_gromacs_acquisition.json gives the installer, package digests and commands).
gaps: no independent backup of the three archives is verified: any further copy found is on the same device as the working copy; the recoverable source is the Dryad record (manual browser download)

the git-ignored derived data (extracted members, work/ intermediates) exist only on this machine; they are hashed here and regenerable from the archives with the committed code, but no regeneration was run
the compiled core (.so) and both Python environments are local builds; their versions and hashes are recorded, not stored
GROMACS 2024.5 is installed outside the repository; only its acquisition record is committed
Set2/system.gro is not published in the Dryad record (D58); it cannot be recovered from the source
